interest: A reusable quiz tool that reduces marking effort and demonstrates teaching innovation
expectation: The sponsor expects a successful MVP demonstration in week 7 and a pilot with 50 students in week 14 within the USD 200 cash cap.

interest: A deliverable project with clear scope, realistic plans and timely decisions
expectation: The PM expects the sponsor to approve the charter and baselines in week 1 and make scope or budget decisions at the agreed gates.

role: Developers and testers: backend, real-time, frontend, QA/DevOps
interest: Clear responsibilities, achievable milestones and a demonstrable portfolio project
expectation: The team expects prioritised requirements, timely reviews and a stable acceptance checklist for the week 7 MVP.

role: End users who join and answer live quizzes
interest: Easy joining, fair timers, quick feedback and a readable leaderboard
expectation: Pilot students expect to join with a code and complete a live quiz with feedback and scores in week 14.

role: Create quizzes, host sessions and review results
interest: Reliable live teaching sessions and less manual marking
expectation: Instructors expect quiz authoring, session controls and a usable leaderboard to work in the week 7 demo.

role: Runs gicitc.com hosting, monitoring and backups
interest: A stable deployment with no surprises at handover
expectation: IT operations expects a deployment checklist, backup and recovery steps, and an operational runbook before the week 14 pilot.

role: Maintains campus proxy and network policy
interest: Secure and supportable traffic through campus infrastructure
expectation: The network administrator expects an early WebSocket connectivity test and a documented SockJS fallback decision by week 5.

interest: Evidence of sound engineering practice and an assessable demonstration
expectation: The course lecturer expects project artefacts, tagged phase commits and demo evidence to be available for assessment.

interest: Student names and scores handled with appropriate access and retention controls
expectation: The data protection stakeholder expects a one-page data description, access rules and a retention decision before the week 14 pilot.

role: Potential adopter and beneficiary next semester
interest: Evidence that the platform benefits teaching and can be operated sustainably
expectation: Faculty management expects a concise pilot outcome report and recommendation for next-semester adoption after week 14.

role: Provides a commercial quiz service if the build is stopped
interest: Clear licence terms, education pricing and account/data arrangements
expectation: The vendor is expected to provide current education pricing and service terms if the sponsor invokes the week 7 fallback gate.
